actual_scope: Prove general-H primary gluing and construct full ordered residual intertwiners for sharp common identity-block Schur deletion over arbitrary fields, with fixed H and ordered input sector dimensions.
scope_change_reason: Handoff-first override: Discussion 5337 and PR5348 leave this algebraic implication open. This is a written side-result proof with exact finite corroboration, not Lean formalization or a selected-caller audit.
bottleneck_link: Removes a stated ambiguity in an algebraic residual-state interface. A consumer and full physical bill are absent; no supplier or kappa gain follows.
stop_rule: Stop after the primary-gluing proof and bounded exact intertwiners, or a counterexample. No state census expansion, header weights, physical implementation or selected-frontier edit.
evidence: README gives a constructive arbitrary-field proof under the credited sharp-sector criterion. verify.py checks 111 complete-H cases, 364 arbitrary sector00 factor pairs, 40 mixed/padded fixtures and eight controls using literal Schur complements and invertible intertwiners for both ordered maps. Finite tests are corroboration, not human or proof-kernel acceptance.
